english.title: Getting onto a motor vehicle / trailer in motion
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or reasonable cause and for the purpose of being carried, got on to

(A)_[a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[a trailer which was attached to a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

in motion on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
